sections.content: A sustained argument connects a position, supporting reasons, concessions and a conclusion. Use connectors to signal movement between ideas and qualify claims when the evidence is limited.

items.spanish: En mi opinión, la propuesta merece apoyo porque ofrece una solución práctica.
items.english: In my opinion, the proposal deserves support because it offers a practical solution.

items.spanish: Aunque tiene algunas limitaciones, sus ventajas son importantes para la comunidad.
items.english: Although it has some limitations, its advantages are important for the community.

items.spanish: Además, la evidencia disponible sugiere que podría funcionar a largo plazo.
items.english: Furthermore, the available evidence suggests that it could work in the long term.

items.spanish: En conclusión, considero que deberíamos aplicarla, siempre que se revisen sus resultados.
items.english: In conclusion, I consider that we should implement it, provided that its results are reviewed.

sections.content: In a debate, acknowledge a reasonable opposing point before explaining why your own conclusion remains stronger.
